body:
# Dualist
Vanilla-style dual wielding / attacking with the offhand

sorry modrinth broke images but just look at the gallery

# Features
- Fully vanilla offhand attack, both visually and mechanically. Uses the vanilla interact keybind (right click)
- Simultaneously attack with main and offhand, or attack with either hand independently
- Balanced gameplay: both hands share the vanilla attack cooldown, which determines damage, sword sweeping, axe shield disabling, etc. Basically, 2x weapons doesn't mean 2x damage

# Compatibility:
Works with shaders, and mods like [First-person Model](https://modrinth.com/mod/first-person-model):


# Other Information
### Dependencies:
None, except for Fabric API if you are on Fabric of course
### Supported Versions:
26.1.2+. Will not backport - feel free to fork it for older versions
### Usage In Modpacks
Yeah that's cool
### Issues?
Report issues [here](https://github.com/StainlessStasis/Dualist/issues)
